overview.description: The GraniteShares 2x Long UBER Daily ETF (UBRL) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in industrials equity. The fund provides 2x leveraged exposure, less fees and expenses, to the daily price movement for shares of Uber Technologies, Inc. stock. UBRL was launched on Sep 3, 2024 and is issued by GraniteShares.
